correctness.rationale: For the smooth codimension-two blow-up Y=Bl_S(P^2 x P^2) with Enriques center, integral blow-up splitting gives H^k(Y)=H^k(X) plus H^{k-2}(S). Enriques H^2=Z^10 plus Z/2, H^3=Z/2, H^1=0 yield H4=Z^13+Z/2, H5=Z/2 and H3=0; no rational-only argument is used. Integral Chow splitting CH2(Y)=CH2(X)+Pic(S), and exponential sequence with h^1(O_S)=h^2(O_S)=0, give the integral cycle isomorphism. Exceptional-intersection self-intersection is negative of Enriques lattice U+E8(-1), ambient H4 is U+<1>, hence U^2+E8(+1)+<1>, signature (11,2), det 1; torsion Poincare linking pairs unique nonzero H4 and H5 to 1/2. Independent exact E8 determinant/Betti/Euler checks match, but do not verify geometric inputs. Note the published 2026 Tufo journal Corollary 3 already correctly lists H5=Z/2, while seemingly incorrectly listing H3=Z/2; arXiv v1 instead sets H5=0. We assess actual mathematical groups rather than treat either table as proof.

value.rationale: The exact middle intersection lattice, integral algebraic cycle realization including torsion, and correction of a cohomology table are natural invariants of a newly described Fano fourfold family. They can distinguish such hosts integrally despite identical rational Hodge data. These are specialized but complete structural calculations, not a random numerical exercise; the ingredients are standard and the contribution is their precise combined application, which limits potential impact.
